name: Business Continuity
description: Readiness to keep critical operations running through disruption.

items.text: Critical business processes and their owners are identified
items.guidance: Start with processes that affect customers or revenue.

items.text: Recovery time and recovery point objectives are set
items.guidance: Agree RTO and RPO with process owners, not just IT.

items.text: Dependencies on systems, people, sites and suppliers are mapped
items.guidance: Identify single points of failure for each critical process.

items.text: Continuity plans exist for each critical process
items.guidance: Keep plans short, action-oriented and accessible offline.
Confirm remote work capacity or an alternate site.

items.text: IT disaster recovery plan aligns with business RTOs
items.guidance: Verify that recovery order matches business priorities.

items.text: Emergency contact lists are current and accessible
items.guidance: Review contact details at least twice a year.
Draft messages for staff, customers and regulators.

items.text: Plans are tested at least annually
items.guidance: Alternate between tabletop exercises and live failover tests.

items.text: Test findings are tracked to closure
items.guidance: Assign owners and due dates to every finding.

items.text: Plans are reviewed after major organisational changes
items.guidance: Trigger a review after restructures, relocations or new systems.
